prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED GOLD flat color field — think #F2C94C, the color
of high-salience memory, attention, and meaning that calls across the
semantic map. The hue must read as CLEAR GOLD, not tan, not cream, not
orange-red severance. Clearly distinct from wastes ochre by being
brighter, cleaner, and more yellow. Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square
edge-to-edge with this one gold color corner to corner — NO drawn hex,
NO paper border, NO vignette, NO centered composition, NO symbols, NO
towers, NO figures, NO script. Only the faintest paint-texture
variation within the same gold hue. A semantic terrain region-fill
swatch, not an illustration.

formatted_prompt.scene: Bold ink and watercolor game-map terrain tile rendered flat and edge-to-edge in vivid clean gold, a single saturated hue filling the entire square with only the faintest brushstroke texture variation within the same golden field.

subjects.description: Uniform flat gold color wash covering the entire 1024x1024 square corner to corner, bright clean yellow-gold with subtle paint-texture variation within the same hue, no symbols or figures
Faint directional brushstroke grain embedded within the gold field, same hue family, slightly warmer in scattered areas, giving the tile tactile board-game material presence
